svg.title: A matrix multiply's tiles going out to an H100's SMs in waves
svg.text: One Matrix Multiply on an H100
C = A × B with M = 512, N = 14,336 and K = 4,096 in BF16. Its 448 output tiles of 128 × 128 go out to 132 SMs, one tile per SM at a time.
wave 4 of 4: 52 of 132 SMs busy, 80 sit idle until it ends
an SM idle in this wave
3.39 waves of work take 4 waves of time, so the GPU runs this multiply at 85% of what its SMs could do
